units.function: Real-PostgreSQL service tests for the persisted Issue-interaction state machine, addressee/resolver governance, suggested-task materialization, question/checkbox/item-verdict validation, supersede/repair, document-revision binding, legacy reads and source-workspace acceptance gates.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> issueThreadInteractionService plus Issue/Agent/instance-settings services -> Drizzle/PostgreSQL Companies, Agents, Runs, Issues, relations, comments, Documents/revisions, interactions, goals/projects and workspace operations.
units.keyDataModels: Versioned interaction payload/result/status; creator/addressee/resolver user/Agent/Run; effective resolver/continuation policy and idempotency key; suggested task graph/responsible user/request depth; partial item verdicts; human-vs-run comment origin; exact Issue-document revision; execution workspace/source Run/finalize operation.
units.lifecycle: Validate active Issue, creator, addressee and current document target -> insert/deduplicate and supersede older requests -> answer/accept/reject/cancel/withdraw or partially resolve -> atomically create child Issues or update interaction -> expire on human comment/newer request/terminal Issue/stale revision/addressee deletion -> repair historical rows -> gate confirmation acceptance on source Run workspace finalization and optionally hand review back to Agent.
units.testAssessment: Both sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs skipped all 51 tests because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable, so this rich intended coverage lacks execution evidence here. It covers many state/validation/compatibility branches but omits concurrent insert/resolve/verdict races, idempotency-key payload mismatch, adversarial tenant IDs, transaction/outbox crash windows, immutable request/event history, resolver role/certification/quorum, exact approval digests and Connector execution receipts.
units.designRationale: Persist human/Agent pauses as structured recoverable state, keep stale questions and confirmations from wedging work, materialize approved task plans safely, bind plan decisions to current revisions and avoid blocking on unrelated or dead workspace operations.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a durable HumanInteraction aggregate for clarification and planning, while risk-bearing actions require a distinct immutable ApprovalObligation/Decision/ExecutionReceipt chain tied to accountable humans, exact data/arguments/evidence and Connector execution.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the typed state machine, creator/addressee/resolver/run identities, invokability chain, responsible-human inheritance, selection validation, partial verdict model, idempotent repair, fail-soft legacy decoding, current-revision transaction lock and source-Run finalize gate. Preserve every request version immutably; use expectedVersion/CAS and scoped idempotency payload hashes; separate Interaction, ReviewObligation and ApprovalObligation; append Decision and Connector Execution receipts through a transactional outbox; require role/certification/quorum and explicit acknowledgment when workspace finalization failed.
units.responsibilityConflict: Stale-target handling mutates payload.target to the latest revision, so the original thing asked is no longer fully represented in the request object. Authorized Agent verdicts and automatic return-to-todo do not establish accountable-human responsibility. Failed workspace finalization still permits acceptance without a tested acknowledgment, and no exact action/data/evidence digest or immutable policy snapshot accompanies the decision.
evidence: git history: twenty-two commits from 814cb336766cabd7c5a08fb82849d93e35a7ddaf through a95739442027bdec8d291030a91e351dc434f635 recorded in the read ledger
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL evidence-integrity conflict: stale-target processing rewrites the request payload instead of preserving immutable original and superseding versions. CRITICAL concurrency gap for Company OS: no CAS/version or simultaneous resolve/verdict/idempotency tests. HIGH approval gap: no exact action/arguments/data/evidence digest, policy snapshot, human certification or quorum. HIGH finalize-risk gap: failed workspace finalization permits accept without explicit acknowledgment/receipt. HIGH verification gap: all real-database tests skipped. MEDIUM tenant gap: company scoping is present but no adversarial cross-tenant test. POSITIVE: server-side current-revision locking, resolver/run provenance, self/same-run barriers, responsible-user inheritance and legacy fail-soft behavior are strong reusable primitives.
